export const IVX_AUTONOMOUS_PROOF_MARKER = 'ivx-autonomous-proof-2026-08-04';

}

type AutonomousProofData = {
  frontendVersion: string;
  backendCommitSha: string;
  lastJobId: string | null;
  lastJobStatus: string | null;
  lastDeploymentTimestamp: string | null;
  shaParity: {
    githubHead: string | null;
    renderDeploySha: string | null;
    healthSha: string | null;
    versionSha: string | null;
    allMatch: boolean;
  };
  verified: boolean;
  marker: string;
  timestamp: string;
};

export async function handleAutonomousProofRequest(request: Request): Promise<Response> {
  await assertIVXOwnerOnly(request, 'autonomous-proof-diagnostics');
  
  // Get current health/commit info
  const healthResp = await fetch('https://api.ivxholding.com/health');
  const health = await healthResp.json() as any;
  const healthSha = health.commit || null;
  
  const versionResp = await fetch('https://api.ivxholding.com/version');
  const version = await versionResp.json() as any;
  const versionSha = version.commit || null;
  
  // Get last worker job
  let lastJobId: string | null = null;
  let lastJobStatus: string | null = null;
  try {
    const { listJobs } = await import('../services/ivx-senior-developer-worker');
    const jobs = await listJobs();
    if (jobs && jobs.length > 0) {
      const lastJob = jobs[0];
      lastJobId = lastJob.jobId || null;
      lastJobStatus = lastJob.status || null;
    }
  } catch {
    // fall through with nulls
  }
  
  // Get GitHub HEAD (from env or API)
  let githubHead: string | null = null;
  try {
    const ghResp = await fetch('https://api.github.com/repos/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform/git/refs/heads/main', {
      headers: { 'Accept': 'application/vnd.github+json' }
    });
    if (ghResp.ok) {
      const ghData = await ghResp.json() as any;
      githubHead = ghData.object?.sha || null;
    }
  } catch {
    // fall through
  }
  
  // Get Render deploy SHA
  let renderDeploySha: string | null = null;
  let lastDeploymentTimestamp: string | null = null;
  try {
    const renderResp = await fetch('https://api.render.com/v1/services/srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0/deploys?limit=1', {
      headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' }
    });
    if (renderResp.ok) {
      const deploys = await renderResp.json() as any[];
      if (deploys && deploys.length > 0) {
        renderDeploySha = deploys[0].commit?.id || null;
        lastDeploymentTimestamp = deploys[0].finishedAt || deploys[0].createdAt || null;
      }
    }
  } catch {
    // fall through
  }
  
  // Use backend commit from health as fallback
  const backendCommitSha = healthSha || process.env.COMMIT_SHA || 'unknown';
  
  // Frontend version from build info
  const frontendVersion = '1.9.5';
  
  // SHA parity check
  const allMatch = !!(githubHead && renderDeploySha && healthSha && versionSha &&
    githubHead === renderDeploySha && renderDeploySha === healthSha && healthSha === versionSha);
  
  const data: AutonomousProofData = {

import { assertIVXOwnerOnly, ownerOnlyJson, ownerOnlyOptions } from './owner-only';
import path from 'node:path';

export const IVX_AUTONOMOUS_PROOF_MARKER = 'ivx-autonomous-proof-2026-08-04';

export function OPTIONS(): Response {
  return ownerOnlyOptions();
}

export async function handleAutonomousProofRequest(request: Request): Promise<Response> {
  await assertIVXOwnerOnly(request, 'autonomous-proof');

  // Get commit SHA from environment
  const backendCommitSha = process.env.COMMIT_SHA || 'unknown';

  // Get GitHub HEAD
  let githubHead: string | null = null;
  try {
    const ghToken = process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN || process.env.RORK_PUBLIC_GITHUB_TOKEN;
    if (ghToken) {
      const resp = await fetch('https://api.github.com/repos/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform/git/refs/heads/main', {
        headers: { 'Authorization': `token ${ghToken}`, 'Accept': 'application/vnd.github+json' }
      });
      if (resp.ok) {
        const data = await resp.json() as any;
        githubHead = data.object?.sha || null;
      }
    }
  } catch {}

  // Get Render deploy SHA
  let renderDeploySha: string | null = null;
  let lastDeploymentTimestamp: string | null = null;
  try {
    const renderKey = process.env.RENDER_API_KEY;
    if (renderKey) {
      const resp = await fetch('https://api.render.com/v1/services/srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0/deploys?limit=1', {
        headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json', 'Authorization': `Bearer ${renderKey}` }
      });
      if (resp.ok) {
        const deploys = await resp.json() as any[];
        if (deploys && deploys.length > 0) {
          renderDeploySha = deploys[0].commit?.id || null;
          lastDeploymentTimestamp = deploys[0].finishedAt || deploys[0].createdAt || null;
        }
      }
    }
  } catch {}

  // Get last worker job
  let lastJobId: string | null = null;
  let lastJobStatus: string | null = null;
  try {
    const { readDurableJson } = await import('../services/ivx-durable-store');
    const storePath = path.join(process.cwd(), 'data', 'ivx-senior-developer-worker-store.json');
    const store = await readDurableJson(storePath);
    const jobs = (store as any)?.jobs || [];
    if (Array.isArray(jobs) && jobs.length > 0) {
      const lastJob = jobs[0];
      lastJobId = lastJob.jobId || lastJob.id || null;
      lastJobStatus = lastJob.status || null;
    }
  } catch {}

  // Get health and version SHAs
  let healthSha: string | null = null;
  let versionSha: string | null = null;
  try {
    const healthResp = await fetch('https://api.ivxholding.com/health');
    if (healthResp.ok) {
      const health = await healthResp.json() as any;
      healthSha = health.commit || null;
    }
  } catch {}
  try {
    const versionResp = await fetch('https://api.ivxholding.com/version');
    if (versionResp.ok) {
      const version = await versionResp.json() as any;
      versionSha = version.commit || null;
    }
  } catch {}

  // SHA parity check
  const allMatch = !!(githubHead && renderDeploySha && healthSha && versionSha &&
    githubHead === renderDeploySha && renderDeploySha === healthSha && healthSha === versionSha);

  return ownerOnlyJson({
    ok: true,
    marker: IVX_AUTONOMOUS_PROOF_MARKER,
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    backendCommitSha,
    githubHead,
    renderDeploySha,
    healthSha,
    versionSha,
    lastJobId,
    lastJobStatus,
    lastDeploymentTimestamp,
    shaParity: allMatch,
    verified: allMatch,
  });
}
